Opens the native camera for a thumbnail, not a full-resolution photo. Hakille keeps only this preview in memory and clears it when leaving this panel. The selected camera may apply its own storage policy.

Local file
The picker requests a local provider. Reading is limited to 1 MiB; text preview to 4 KiB. No upload to the hub and no durable copy. Local-only selection depends on the Android provider.

Opens your maps app without passing any coordinates. That app may use its own networks, accounts and location permissions. Hakille does not create a route or control it.
Opens the browser at https://github.com/hakille/hakille. The browser will contact GitHub using its own cookies and network settings. No file, photo or location is attached.
